visualize_mot_errors_cv2: visualize multi-object tracking errors on an image using OpenCV with colored bounding boxes for false positives, false negatives, and ID switches
visualize_mot_errors_matplotlib: visualize multi-object tracking errors on an image using matplotlib with colored bounding boxes and text labels for each error type
show_wrong_tracks_cv2: show wrong tracking tracks with OpenCV by drawing colored rectangles and labels for false positives, false negatives, and ID switches on an image
show_wrong_tracks_matplotlib: show wrong tracking tracks with matplotlib by drawing colored rectangles and text annotations for each error type on an image
save_mot_error_visualization: save a multi-object tracking error visualization to a file with bounding boxes colored by error type using either cv2 or matplotlib backend
